name: LanDeng Incense Form Database
description: Machine-readable definitions of Chinese botanical incense forms — sticks, coils, cones, powder, resin, pills, beads, and the prepared low-smoke / smokeless categories. Extracted from the LanDeng (澜灯) incense encyclopedia; every fact is traceable to a source page, and unverified facts are marked unverified.

mainEntity.name: Incense Stick
mainEntity.description: 线香 (xiànxiāng) — the everyday default incense form: a thin rod of fragrant material, either a bamboo-core coated in paste or a coreless stick pressed from the material itself.

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: bamboo-core (thin splint coated in paste) or coreless (solid paste, no core)

additionalProperty.name: Use case
additionalProperty.value: daily use, meditation, timed sessions; the everyday default

sources.title: Incense Sticks: The Everyday Format, Explained
Which Incense Format Is Right for You?

mainEntity.name: Incense Coil
mainEntity.description: 盘香 (pánxiāng) — the hours-long incense form: a spiral laid flat on a stand, burning continuously for long, steady room scent.

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: spiral, laid flat on a stand or plate

additionalProperty.name: Use case
additionalProperty.value: long, continuous room scent; temples, long ceremonies

sources.title: Which Incense Format Is Right for You?
Incense Burn Time Format Matrix: Stick to Powder

mainEntity.name: Incense Cone
mainEntity.description: 塔香 (tǎxiāng, "tower incense") — the conical self-supporting incense form that burns down completely, for a short, self-contained session or the backflow visual effect.

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: self-supporting cone that burns down completely

additionalProperty.name: Use case
additionalProperty.value: short ritual, quick accent; backflow visual effect

sources.title: Which Incense Format Is Right for You?
Incense Burn Time Format Matrix: Stick to Powder

mainEntity.name: Backflow Cone
mainEntity.description: 倒流香 (dàoliúxiāng) — a hollow incense cone with a central channel, chosen almost entirely for its downward-smoke waterfall effect on a purpose-built burner.

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: hollow cone with a channel drilled through its center

additionalProperty.name: Intensity
additionalProperty.value: high (visual) — denser, lingering smoke for the waterfall

additionalProperty.name: Use case
additionalProperty.value: the waterfall-smoke visual effect; decorative centerpiece

sources.title: Backflow Incense Cones: The Waterfall Effect

mainEntity.name: Incense Powder
mainEntity.description: 香粉 (xiāngfěn) — loose ground incense material, pressed into seal patterns (篆香) or heated directly for a pure-material scent.

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: loose ground wood/resin; pressed into seal patterns or heated

additionalProperty.name: Burn time
additionalProperty.value: depends on method (heated = session-based; pressed seal pattern = lit along the pattern)

additionalProperty.name: Intensity
additionalProperty.value: varies by method — minimal (heated) to moderate (lit seal pattern)

additionalProperty.name: Use case
additionalProperty.value: seal patterns (篆香), custom blends; pure-material scent

sources.title: Incense Burn Time Format Matrix: Stick to Powder

mainEntity.name: Incense Pill
mainEntity.description: 香丸 (xiāngwán) — the classical 合香 delivery form: a kneaded compound-incense pellet, bound with honey, rolled into pills and air-dried before burning.

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: kneaded compound bound with honey, rolled into pills, coated and air-dried

additionalProperty.name: Burn time
additionalProperty.value: unverified (burned as a pellet; no duration stated in sources)

sources.title: The 合香 Blending System: Composed Like a Formula

mainEntity.name: Incense Cake
mainEntity.description: 香饼 (xiāngbǐng) — incense cake; a pressed-cake incense form. Not documented in the current LanDeng corpus; all fields are marked unverified.

mainEntity.name: Incense Plaque
mainEntity.description: 香牌 (xiāngpái) — incense plaque / tablet; a pressed or carved incense form. Recorded as a term; construction and burn facts are unverified in the current corpus.

mainEntity.name: Incense Bead
mainEntity.description: 香珠 (xiāngzhū) — incense beads / aromatherapy beads: porous beads (wood, stone, or clay) scented with essential oil and worn, so aroma releases slowly as a personal, zero-smoke scent.

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: porous beads (wood/stone/clay) scented with essential oil, strung into bracelets or necklaces

additionalProperty.name: Burn time
additionalProperty.value: n/a — worn, not burned (scent fades over days–weeks, refreshed with oil)

sources.title: Aromatherapy Beads & Bracelets: Worn, Not Burned

mainEntity.name: Bamboo-Core Stick
mainEntity.description: 竹签香 (zhúqiānxiāng) — the bamboo-core stick construction: a thin bamboo splint coated in incense paste, sturdier and longer-burning than a coreless stick.

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: thin bamboo splint coated in incense paste

additionalProperty.name: Intensity
additionalProperty.value: moderate (adds a little wood smoke from the core)

additionalProperty.name: Use case
additionalProperty.value: sturdier, longer stick; common in India and China

sources.title: Incense Sticks: The Everyday Format, Explained

mainEntity.name: Low-Smoke Incense
mainEntity.description: 微烟香 (wēiyānxiāng) — low-smoke incense; a prepared category of reduced-smoke incense. The term is recorded; detailed construction and burn facts are unverified in the current corpus (thin/coreless sticks are noted as lower-smoke).

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: unverified (thin/coreless sticks are noted as lower-smoke)

sources.title: Incense Sticks: The Everyday Format, Explained

mainEntity.name: Smokeless Incense
mainEntity.description: 无烟香 (wúyānxiāng) — smokeless incense; a prepared category of no-smoke incense. The term is recorded; detailed construction and burn facts are unverified in the current corpus (electric-heated resin is the least-smoky method).

additionalProperty.name: Construction
additionalProperty.value: unverified (electric-heated resin is noted as least smoky)

sources.title: Which Incense Format Is Right for You?
